activateModal.title: Activate RFID card
activateModal.description: Are you sure you want to activate the RFID card? This will deactivate all other RFID cards you have.

deactivateModal.title: Deactivate RFID card
deactivateModal.description: Are you sure you want to deactivate the RFID card? You can activate it again later.

deleteModal.title: Delete RFID Card
deleteModal.description: You are about to delete the RFID Card with the ID {{id}}. This action cannot be undone.

deleteUidOnlyModal.title: Delete UID-only card
deleteUidOnlyModal.description: You are about to delete the UID-only RFID Card with the ID {{id}}. Nothing is written to such a card, so no reader is needed. This action cannot be undone.

enrollModal.title: Enroll RFID Card
enrollModal.description: To enroll a new RFID Card, choose a connected Attractap in the list below. Then click on the button "Enroll new RFID Card" and follow the instructions on the Attractap.
